number.why: The served SAE counts are correct: 38/250 versus 25/127, yielding a reconstructed OR of (38×102)/(212×25)=0.7313207547. These are safety-population outcomes through day 60. The ruling correctly identifies the incorrect modified intention-to-treat label. The OR is calculated from counts, not a published OR with a published CI.

quotes.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 38 of 250 patients (15.2%) in the tocilizumab group and 25 of 127 patients (19.7%) in the placebo group.
Table 3 Adverse Events through Day 60 in the Safety Population.
Safety was assessed in all the patients who received either tocilizumab or placebo; patients were grouped according to the actual agent received.

entry.why: Eligibility explicitly establishes hospitalized adults with confirmed COVID-19 pneumonia. The hypoxic, nonventilated population is a restricted subset within the question's population; this does not establish applicability to every hospitalized subgroup or establish mortality benefit.

quotes.span: Patients who were 18 years of age or older (with no upper age limit) and who were hospitalized with Covid-19 pneumonia that had been confirmed by a positive polymerase-chain-reaction test and radiographic imaging were eligible for enrollment.

Patients had a blood oxygen saturation below 94% while breathing ambient air but were excluded if they were receiving continuous positive airway pressure, bilevel positive airway pressure, or mechanical ventilation.
